preconditions.description: The number of testcases t must be between 1 and 10,000.

The length of each permutation m must be between 1 and 10.

preconditions.expression: all(len(a) == m for a in permutations)

preconditions.expression: all(set(a) == set(range(1, m + 1)) for a in permutations)
preconditions.description: Each permutation must contain distinct integers from 1 to m.

postconditions.description: The output must contain n integers corresponding to the largest beauty for each permutation.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= beauty <= m for beauty in output)
postconditions.description: Each beauty value in the output must be between 0 and m.
